rationale.consistency: Mirrors v6 idioms (idempotency key, closeResponse, httperr classification) but adds a hand-rolled retrying HTTP client, a pointer ResponseError unlike v6's value type, and a new clientcfg package v6 didn't need.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles 409 find-by-name, missing upload URL, aborted/completed during polling, ctx cancellation, PushRefID precedence, unparseable durations; unknown abort reasons fall to code 0 and StackID 0 is sent when unset.
rationale.scope: Core flow is delivered, but adds a clientcfg refactor, an unused k6cloud APIClient in the provisioning client, and unrequested mapping of max_samples_per_package onto MaxTimeSeriesInBatch.
rationale.readability: Clear names and purposeful comments; some redundant nil/constant guards in HTTPClient.Do and a shadowed err in expv2 Start.
rationale.robustness: Bodies closed, timers stopped, request body replayed on retry, 5xx retried; notify uses Background ctx relying on client timeout, and a client-creation failure silently falls back to the legacy v1 end-of-test call.
rationale.maintainability: CreateOrFindLoadTest duplicates createTest, HTTPClient is constructed per call in three places, and provisioning mode hinges on lazy detection of two config strings plus a bool flag, a subtle hidden coupling.
